format: NDCA Sanctioned events, definition of a couple

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A couple is a leader and follower 'without regard to the sex or gender of the dancer' across all classifications.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must define every couple as a leader and a follower regardless of sex or gender, in all classifications (professional, amateur, pro/am student, student/student, mixed amateur).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: Consistent with Studio's role model, which needs no gender. Not a requirement to collect gender. The relation to II.B.7.c (OD27-NDCA-0003) is a question for the owner. NDCA effective_from 2026-06-01 is a placeholder convention shared with sibling entries; the rule book states only 'June 2026 EDITION' (OD-30), so the effective date is not verified.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
